Alternative (non religious based) theory to evolution

There is one that is a different take on evolution. Basically the theory is that evolution is due to sudden beneficial mutations in members of a species. Like a fish being hatched with gills that work above water. If the mutation is beneficial it will be more likely to breed into the rest of the population making that mutation more prevalent.

So same as evolution but think of steps instead of a ramp.

Punctuated equilibrium. What is says is that at the genetic level species continue to evolve but when they're in a stable environment any changes aren't beneficial so the population appears to not change for a long period of time, but then when there's a change in climate for example, there will be some members of the population who have an advantage over others so dominate. Working off the fossil record we can see events like this where a species lasts a very long time and then is suddenly replaced. However, it isn't really that there's a sudden beneficial mutation, more like the environment changed and the original population died out to be replaced by another that migrated in. Quick changes happen over the course of a small amount of geological time such as a million years so when we say sudden that's the scale we're working with. The fish example is actually interesting because gills couldn't work on land but we know the gills evolved from the swim bladder as teleost fish are able to pump oxygen in and out of it to maintain buoyancy but also allowed fish to hold oxygen and pull it back into their blood leading to lung fish. This is typically how evolution works though, a feature that evolves for one reason is repurposed and reused. Sometimes this leaves us with weird situations that any competent designer would never do but evolution isn't guided, it is a process of change and selection in response to environmental pressure.

Evolution isn't a lie, it is an observed fact. We know it happens. The evidence is in the fossil record and in our genetic codes. We can build phylogenetic trees from DNA that show that all species have evolved. The people who deny evolution are denying reality, plain and simple. As for the theory of evolution? Well, that's been tested and refined over the last century, has made predictions which have proven correct and thus it is one of the most well accepted theories science has today. That doesn't stop us continuing to test and refine it but I highly doubt there will be an alternative since what we have fits the evidence so well and that's why it is has been elevated to theory level from just being an hypothesis.

TL;DR - Evolution happens, the theory just describes how we think it works.
